[[File:Ithorian-Human-Baragwin.jpg|thumb|250px|An [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] playing holochess against a [[Unidentified Human scoundrel|Human]] opponent, as a [[Baragwin/Legends|Baragwin]] observes]]

'''Holochess''' was a [[Chess/Legends|chess]] game that utilized [[Hologram/Legends|holographic]] representations of the playing pieces, often exotic [[Alien/Legends|aliens]]. It was played for entertainment and [[Gambling/Legends|gambling]]. The rules differed from regular chess, as it was played on a circular board, rather than square. Holochess differed on crucial points from [[Dejarik/Legends|dejarik]] and [[holochex]].<ref name="The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia">{{CSWECite|II|51|Holochess}}</ref> The [[Tralla Room]] on the ''[[Coral Vanda]]'' had several holochess tables.

Variations included [[Dejarik/Legends|Dejarik]], [[Denebian holo-chess|Denebian Holochess]], [[Divoran holochess|Divoran Holochess]], [[Holochex]], and [[Moebius/Legends|Moebius chess]].
